summary: Tested Inventory page 'Resolve Missing Values' (Deep Backfill) bug-fix scoped to resilient polling + stopped_early bounded runtime. Nulled a handful of component_master.product_uuid values to exercise the running->refreshing_cache->result flow via both direct API polling (curl) and full Playwright UI test. Also regression-tested search/category/site filters, Refresh (live SAP pull job), and smoke-tested BOM Explorer/Purchasing Plan/Production Plan/Admin pages.
critical_code_review_comments: inventory_service.py deep_backfill_uuids(): ThreadPoolExecutor/as_completed with wall-clock deadline correctly implemented; stopped_early set once deadline passes and remaining futures cancelled; executor.shutdown(wait=False, cancel_futures=True) avoids blocking - good non-blocking design.
server.py DeepBackfillResult model correctly includes stopped_early: bool = False, verified via live GET /api/inventory/deep-backfill-uuids/{job_id} response.

InventoryPage.js polling loops (refreshFromSap, startDeepBackfill) now retry up to 5 consecutive failures before surfacing error, resetting counter on each success - correctly resilient to transient blips; verified Close button is disabled while status==running and enabled after done.

Could not directly exercise the stopped_early=true UI banner (data-testid=inventory-deep-backfill-stopped-early-warning) in this preview because the SAP tenant responded fast for the small number of nulled items (8 items resolved in ~3s, well under the 360s deadline) - only total:0/false and total:8/resolved:8/false paths were exercised. Code review confirms the stopped_early logic and its UI rendering (banner + messaging) are correctly wired, but this specific banner was not visually confirmed on screen.
test_credentials: No app auth. SAP/OMS creds confirmed present in backend/.env per /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
seed_data_creation: Nulled product_uuid for a handful of component_master docs (matching product_ids in inventory_cache.items) via pymongo script to force non-zero 'total' in deep backfill runs - per agent_to_agent_context_note, acceptable preview test data mutation, not restored.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Deep Backfill bug fix verified working end-to-end: dialog opens -> running state with progress bar and 'Checking X of Y...' text -> phase transitions to 'refreshing_cache' ('Links resolved - refreshing inventory valuations...') -> result panel shows 'Resolved X of Y'. Close button correctly disabled while running, enabled + functional after done. GET /api/inventory/deep-backfill-uuids/{job_id} returns total/resolved/still_missing/material_lookup_unauthorized/stopped_early (all correct types, stopped_early defaults false). Refresh button (GET /api/inventory/{job_id} polling) also completes normally (~105s for full 3177-item live SAP pull) without freezing. Regression: search box, category filter (Uncategorized), site filter (All Sites dropdown with 9 sites) all functional. BOM Explorer, Purchasing Plan, Production Plan, Admin pages all load without errors - no regressions from this change. Only gap: stopped_early=true UI banner not visually triggered (would require either a much larger backlog of missing UUIDs or an artificially shortened DEEP_BACKFILL_MAX_RUNTIME_SECONDS for testing) - code review confirms correct implementation.
rca of the issue: N/A - this was a fix verification session, not a new bug investigation. No new bugs found.
